decisions.rationale: Test fully set-based execution to establish the lower bound on consistent gets, alongside bulk variants and cache combinations to map the I/O versus PGA trade-off frontier.
Test selective caching and bulk sizes: s1 with cache and bulk processing while s3/s6 vary to isolate memory impact from cache vs bulk buffers, probing the trade-off space between 2.5MB and 28MB PGA.

Caching s4/s5 in s3 while setting s1 to SET_BASED drastically reduces buffer gets with moderate PGA; test partial caching across s4 and s5 to pinpoint PGA drivers and find intermediate Pareto frontiers.
Caching s4 consumes high memory (~28MB) while s5 consumes ~600KB. Testing s2=LOOKUP_SQL vs caching patterns, plus ROW/BULK combinations to balance f1 and low f2 near 2.4-3.0MB.
Test low-memory variants using ROW or small BULK with LOOKUP_SQL or selective caches to expand the low-f2 boundary around 2112KB-2496KB.
Combine caching on s5 with low-overhead ROW/BULK settings on s1 and s3 to explore intermediate Pareto trade-offs around 3-4 MB memory without heavy R1 table caching.
Combine BULK on s1 and s3 with full LOOKUP_CACHE and s6=SET_BASED across various limit sizes to push the lower bound of f1 while tracking memory scaling.
Test caching on s1 alone or selectively across s1/s3 to explore intermediate trade-offs between 7K and 38K f1, and test ROW on s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE for s5.
Evaluating combinations with caching only on s5 (low memory overhead, high f1 reduction) paired with row/bulk variants of s1 and set-based s6 to improve low-memory Pareto frontiers.
Evaluating intermediate caching profiles and low-memory bulk configurations across s1 and s3 to populate the Pareto front between 7k and 78k gets at low memory footprints.
Test low-memory configurations combining SET_BASED and ROW variants with selective caching to identify optimal Pareto trade-offs in intermediate buffer sizes.
Test caching only lookup table R2 (s5) with SET_BASED/ROW combinations to find intermediate low-PGA, low-f1 configurations.
Test low-memory configurations combining SET_BASED s1 and s6 with LOOKUP_CACHE only on s5, and explore cache trade-offs on ROW s1 to beat the 2112KB-2496KB low PGA boundary.
Test s4/s5 cache combinations with ROW s1 or SET_BASED s1, targeting unmeasured low-PGA/low-f1 trade-offs around 27-28MB and probing unexplored minimal cache footprints.
Test s4=LOOKUP_CACHE with s5=LOOKUP_SQL under SET_BASED or lower memory settings, and explore s1=ROW/BULK with minimal caches to find non-dominated low memory Pareto trade-offs.

Evaluating intermediate low-memory configurations where s5=LOOKUP_CACHE (very low PGA overhead) is combined with SET_BASED or BULK for s1 and s3, targeting improvements on the low-PGA Pareto frontier.
Test caching only s5 with s1=SET_BASED, s6=SET_BASED and varying s3 (BULK_50/500), which previously achieved ~78k gets at low memory, plus low-memory permutations with s1=ROW.

Test low-memory Pareto frontier: combining s3=SET_BASED or s1=SET_BASED with minimal PGA configurations, especially testing if s3 BULK with s5 cache improves memory-read trade-offs without large associative arrays.
Test caching only s5 with s1=SET_BASED, s3=ROW/BULK, and s6=SET_BASED, exploring memory/consistent gets trade-offs around low-PGA pareto boundaries.
Test untested combinations targeting the low-PGA/moderate-f1 frontier, specifically combining s1=BULK_50/ROW with s3=BULK and s5=LOOKUP_CACHE to undercut existing points near 2.4MB-2.8MB PGA.
Test fully set-based execution to establish minimum consistent gets, along with varied bulk sizes and caching to map memory vs I/O trade-offs.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces logical I/O (f1) at high PGA cost (f2). Testing mixed configurations with SET_BASED or selective caching explores intermediate trade-offs between f1 ~7k and ~79k with lower memory footprint.
Test BULK_5000 with SET_BASED s6 and LOOKUP_CACHE to push f1 lower. Also isolate cache costs between s2 vs s4/s5 to identify low-memory caching opportunities.
Investigate selective cache combinations (s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with s4=LOOKUP_SQL) and intermediate bulk sizes for low PGA and balanced gets.
Config 19 showed that caching only s5 with SET_BASED s1/s6 uses only 3072KB PGA. Testing s4 alone or mixing s2/s5 caching tests the low-PGA/moderate-f1 frontier.
Notice #19 used LOOKUP_CACHE only for R2 (s5), incurring only 3072KB PGA instead of ~29MB from R1 (s2/s4). Testing s1=BULK with s5=LOOKUP_CACHE should yield massive f1 drops at low PGA.
Evaluate SET_BASED across s1/s6 while exploring s4=LOOKUP_CACHE with s5=LOOKUP_SQL or combining s3 bulk alternatives to find low-memory trade-offs between 3MB and 28MB PGA.
Notice s5 (LOOKUP_CACHE on R2) costs minimal PGA (~200-600KB) unlike R1. Testing s1=SET_BASED, s3 with cached R2 (s5=LOOKUP_CACHE), and different bulk levels or exploring s1 bulk variants.
Test low-memory alternatives around ROW/BULK for s1, s3, s6 while keeping minimal cache overhead to find lower f2 Pareto trade-offs.
Testing s1=ROW and s1=SET_BASED with cache combos, plus ROW on s6 to probe the extreme low-memory Pareto region and explore s2 caching with s3=SET_BASED.

Test low-memory trade-offs around Pareto #39 and #50 by combining s1=SET_BASED with s3=BULK and s5=LOOKUP_CACHE to discover lower f1 without incurring the large cache memory penalty seen when caching R1.
Test low-memory alternatives combining SET_BASED across key sites or pairing intermediate bulkings with LOOKUP_SQL/LOOKUP_CACHE to bridge the Pareto front between 2.1MB and 2.5MB.
Combine low-PGA partial caching (s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with s4=LOOKUP_SQL) with SET_BASED and small bulk variants to discover low-f1, low-f2 trade-offs.
Test combinations of low-overhead ROW or BULK_50 on s1 with cache options on s4/s5 or SET_BASED to fill gaps along the Pareto front between 2112KB and 28608KB PGA.
Evaluating s1=ROW with cache combinations tests lower-PGA bounds in cache regimes, while exploring s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with s1=ROW examines low-memory Pareto tradeoffs against #70, #71, and #19.
Combine caching of s2 and s4/s5 with varying batch sizes, or test caching isolated to s5 while keeping s1 and s3 minimal to explore unvisited low-PGA/intermediate-f1 trade-offs.
Exploiting low-memory configurations around s1=SET_BASED, s3=SET_BASED and testing BULK_5000 combinations to explore lower bounds on f1 and boundary trade-offs between buffer gets and PGA.
Test low-memory configurations combining s1=ROW/BULK with s3=SET_BASED, and probe s1=SET_BASED with s3 cache to bridge low-f1 and low-f2 trade-offs.
Test low-memory trade-offs by pairing SET_BASED at s1 and s6 with ROW at s3, probing LOOKUP_CACHE options on s4/s5 or exploring BULK_50 on s3 with LOOKUP_SQL.
Test low PGA configurations where s3 caches only R2 or combines BULK with low-overhead lookups, targeting the gap between f2=2112KB and 28608KB.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops for maximum I/O reduction, followed by BULK and LOOKUP_CACHE variants to explore memory and I/O trade-offs across different cursor workloads.

LOOKUP_CACHE dramatically reduces logical I/O at the cost of high PGA. Evaluate SET_BASED combined with bulk variants and selective LOOKUP_CACHE caching on individual loops to discover intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Test cache combinations selectively (isolating s4/s5 vs s2 cache footprint) and evaluate BULK_5000 with SET_BASED DMLs to optimize the lowest logical I/O corner with lower memory.

Caching individual lookup tables while using SET_BASED or smaller batch sizes helps isolate memory cost vs consistent gets trade-offs, especially testing selective caches with s3=SET_BASED or s1=SET_BASED.
Notice #18 achieves f1=78022 at only 3072KB by caching only s5. Caching only s4 or combinations with BULK_50/BULK_500 in s3 can explore the low-memory, medium-gets trade-off front.
Evaluating ROW on s3 with s5 cached tests low memory overhead against s1=SET_BASED, while testing BULK_5000 with mixed caching probes finer f1-f2 trade-offs.
Test low-memory variants around s1=ROW/BULK_50 with s3=SET_BASED, as well as s5=LOOKUP_CACHE to exploit low-memory caching on R2 without caching R1.
Explores combinations of low-memory row/bulk baselines with selective lookup caching or pure set-based updates to target the unpopulated frontier between 2112KB and 28608KB PGA.
Test s4=LOOKUP_CACHE with s5=LOOKUP_SQL under low memory to see if R1 cache alone scales memory moderately, and explore ROW/BULK combinations.
Testing s4/s5 cache combinations with ROW/BULK at s1, and probing whether s2=LOOKUP_CACHE with s3=BULK_500 s4=LOOKUP_SQL s5=LOOKUP_CACHE improves the trade-off near 30MB PGA.
Explores the frontier below SET_BASED s1/s3 by testing BULK_5000/BULK_500 on s6 or combinations of LOOKUP_CACHE at s2/s4/s5 to map the sharp trade-off between logical reads and memory.
Test combinations of BULK_500 with full caching to minimize f1, alongside lower-memory configurations using BULK_50 and LOOKUP_CACHE for s5 to refine the low f1-f2 boundary.
Test caching on s4 or combinations with ROW s1/s6 and SET_BASED/BULK to explore lower-PGA frontiers without full triple-cache memory overhead.

Explores the low-memory Pareto frontier where s1=ROW and s3=SET_BASED achieved minimal PGA (2112KB), testing whether different s6 settings or s1=BULK_50 combinations reduce f1 further while maintaining low memory.
Evaluating intermediate PGA configurations with s5=LOOKUP_CACHE (very low PGA overhead compared to s2/s4) alongside BULK/SET options to probe the Pareto gap between f1=78k (2496KB) and f1=38k (29MB).
Evaluating intermediate PGA-cache trade-offs (only s5 cached, or hybrid bulk sizes) against set-based/low PGA baselines to discover Pareto frontiers between 2.4MB-30MB PGA.
Test minimal memory configurations using ROW/BULK with LOOKUP_SQL and SET_BASED s6, and explore s4=CACHE / s5=SQL trade-offs with SET_BASED ancestors to push Pareto boundaries.
Test low-PGA configurations combining SET_BASED at s1/s6 with selective caching or minimal bulk sizing to discover improved f1-f2 trade-offs around 2-3MB memory.
Evaluating combinations mixing SET_BASED s1, s6 with single low-memory cache lookups (s5=LOOKUP_CACHE) and varying s3 batching, plus pure low-PGA alternatives targeting gaps in the Pareto front.
Evaluating BULK_500 at s1 with ROW at s3 and full caching tests if low f1 can be obtained with intermediate memory, while checking s1=ROW with partial s5 caching for low memory Pareto improvements.
Test pure SET_BASED vs BULK variants and LOOKUP_CACHE caching to establish boundary trade-offs for logical I/O and PGA memory.
Test isolating cache impact: evaluate BULK loops with LOOKUP_CACHE only on s1/s2, and test pure SET_BASED combinations to explore intermediate PGA-f1 frontiers between 2.5MB and 28MB.
Test isolating cache lookups across s2 vs s4/s5 to check memory footprints, and evaluate SET_BASED with BULK combinations to locate intermediate Pareto trade-offs.
Notice s4 (cache of R1) inflates memory to ~28MB, whereas s5 (cache of R2) costs only ~3MB (seen in config 15). We test caching s2/s5 without s4 to achieve intermediate f1 and low f2.

Caching s5 (R2) costs minimal PGA (~3MB vs ~28MB for R1 at s2/s4). Testing combinations where s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with SQL/SET_BASED elsewhere to find intermediate Pareto points between 2.5MB and 28MB PGA.
Notice s5 (R2 lookup) consumes minimal PGA (~3MB) compared to s2/s4 (R1 lookup ~30MB). Pairing s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with s1=BULK and s3=BULK without caching s2/s4 could reduce f1 at low PGA.
Test ROW at s1 with low-memory set-based/cache combinations to explore the minimum-PGA Pareto frontier, and combine s1=BULK_5000 with full cache to push minimum f1.
Explores minimal PGA configurations around s3=SET_BASED with ROW/BULK variants, and tests s1=ROW with s3=SET_BASED combinations to push the lowest memory boundary on the Pareto frontier.

Test low-PGA configurations combining s3=SET_BASED or s3=LOOKUP_CACHE with ROW/BULK variants at s1 and s6, and explore BULK_5000 combinations at s3 to tighten the Pareto front around 37k-77k f1 and <3MB f2.
Test s1=ROW with LOOKUP_CACHE to achieve lower memory overhead when caching G03_SHARED_SPARSE_R1, and explore unexamined LOOKUP_CACHE combinations across s1 and s3.
Test minimal memory and intermediate Pareto trade-offs by combining ROW or SET_BASED with LOOKUP_CACHE configurations.
Test minimal memory footprint combinations with ROW/SET_BASED, and check if s1=SET_BASED combined with selective lookup caching or intermediate bulk sizes improves trade-offs on the Pareto boundary.
Refine the low-memory and mid-memory Pareto regions: explore combinations of s3=BULK_* with s4=LOOKUP_SQL and s5=LOOKUP_SQL under SET_BASED or ROW s1/s6 to push boundaries near 2-3MB PGA.
Test caching on s5 with low-PGA baselines, and evaluate s4 caching isolations or s1=SET_BASED / s3=BULK blends to improve Pareto coverage between 2.5MB and 28MB PGA.
Test minimal memory trade-offs where s1 and s3 use LOOKUP_SQL or selective caches, pairing BULK_50/ROW with SET_BASED to discover lower f2 with moderate f1.
Test caching only s4 or s2+s4 while using SET_BASED/BULK to explore lower-buffer reads under moderate PGA, filling Pareto gaps.
Test BULK_50 on s1 with ROW or BULK_5000 on s3 alongside full LOOKUP_CACHE to explore the low f1 / ~30MB memory trade-off border.
Test caching only lookup s4 or combining bulk settings to find intermediate trade-offs between low PGA (SQL lookup) and low consistent gets (full caching).
Test s1=ROW/BULK with s3=SET_BASED and partial caching, and explore lower memory BULK combinations targeting trade-offs near the Pareto frontier.

Test minimal memory configs by combining s1=ROW/BULK_50 with s3=SET_BASED and s6=SET_BASED, and explore whether partial caching (s4=CACHE, s5=SQL) without s2 cache provides a lower PGA Pareto frontier point.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops to establish the lower bound for consistent gets, along with varying bulk sizes and lookup cache combinations to explore the I/O vs memory frontier.
Evaluate mixing SET_BASED loops with selective LOOKUP_CACHE vs BULK without cache to discover intermediate points on the trade-off curve between low f1 (gets) and low f2 (PGA memory).
Test s6=SET_BASED combined with selective caching to lower f1 beyond BULK_5000/CACHE and discover low-memory hybrids with intermediate caching.
Test isolating cache lookups across s2, s4, and s5 individually with SET_BASED or BULK to find intermediate PGA-f1 trade-offs between 2.5MB and 28MB.

Evaluating selective caching combinations: isolating s5 caching (R2) which uses only ~3MB PGA while cutting logical I/O, and testing s2-only caching paired with SET_BASED downstream to map low-memory regions.
Caching s5 alone keeps memory low (~3MB) while significantly reducing f1. Testing intermediate combinations with s1=BULK and s5=CACHE, plus ROW variations to find non-dominated low-memory points.
Eval 29 achieved the minimum PGA (2112KB) by setting s1=ROW. Testing s6 variants with s1=ROW and exploring caching combinations to probe low PGA and low logical I/O trade-offs.
Test combination of low memory ROW/BULK_50 on s1 with low f1 LOOKUP_CACHE on s4/s5 or explore trade-offs between SET_BASED and cache.
Evaluate SET_BASED across s1 and s6 while testing combinations of s3 with selective LOOKUP_CACHE (s5 or s4) to find low-memory trade-offs between 78k and 53k gets without caching s4.
Test low-PGA configurations combining s3=SET_BASED or s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with ROW/BULK_50 on other sites to explore the low memory frontier (2-3 MB) between 79k and 113k gets.
Test minimal memory alternatives by evaluating ROW on s6 with Pareto candidates, and explore if s3=SET_BASED combined with minimal PGA options yields lower memory than 2112KB.
Test low-memory configurations combining minimal caching (s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with s4=LOOKUP_SQL) or ROW/BULK variants, targeting missing trade-off regions between f1=78k and f1=93k with low f2.
Testing s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with s1=ROW and s3=SET_BASED, plus exploring minimal memory configurations around s1=ROW/SET_BASED to discover new Pareto points balancing low PGA and consistent gets.

Test low-memory combinations with minimal buffer cache usage by combining ROW/BULK at s1 with SET_BASED downstream, or evaluating whether s4=LOOKUP_SQL, s5=LOOKUP_CACHE with s1=BULK_50 offers new Pareto trade-offs.
Test caching on s1 combined with ROW/BULK s3, exploring lower memory variants along the f1 7k-17k front, and probe s6 SET_BASED optimizations.
Evaluating s1=SET_BASED combined with partial/full cache on s3 (or s1=ROW with cache) to discover finer trade-offs between ~2.5MB and 29MB PGA while pushing logical I/O lower.
Test s4=LOOKUP_CACHE with s5=LOOKUP_SQL under low memory (SET_BASED / SQL) and evaluate combinations exploring low-f1 vs medium-memory trade-offs.
Test caching only s4 vs s5 selectively and explore ROW/BULK combinations that bridge low PGA and low gets.
Evaluating intermediate points combining s1 BULK or ROW with selective lookup caching and s3 SET_BASED or BULK to uncover missing Pareto frontiers between minimal PGA and minimal gets.
Test low-memory Pareto boundaries by pairing low-overhead row/bulk cursor forms with lookup caches or SET_BASED joins to exploit gaps between 2MB-28MB memory and 17k-79k gets.
